units.translation: Some also place Lyrnessus in the plain of Thebe, as Aeschylus, calling Andromache Lyrnessian in the Phrygians; where he also tells a strange story, saying she was the daughter of Andraemon: “the offspring of Andraemon of Lyrnessus, from where Hector brought his dear wife.”
heavenly songs – becoming releasable for me.
with the raging blast of madness.
and madness and vain fear from the nights.

what path could they cut as a releaser of marriage? Thus I emended what is in M: τίν᾽ ἀμφ᾿ αὐτᾶς ἔτι πόρον τέμνω γάμου καὶ λυτήρια [what path around her should I still cut for marriage and release?]. Schuetz had corrected to γάμου λυτήρα [releaser of marriage].
O friendly gods, releasers, standing around the city.
so that it might become a release for me from these things.
cutting remedies and releasers of these things.
price by which captives are redeemed
For what ransom (thus Canterus for λυγρόν [baneful]) is there for blood fallen to the ground?
Who then is the one who will release you?
who will release me from these toils.
to release me from these bonds.
others have released many nooses from above my neck.
let someone quickly loosen the sandals beneath, which is said by tmesis for ὑπολύοι [should loosen beneath].
he might release the fetters (or you might release?).
but he did not resolve the quarrel by taking silver.
release the blood of deeds done long ago.
for the people have been released to speak freely, as the yoke of strength was released.
not at all, unless I am released from bonds.
you still being released from these bonds.
I want to advise you the best things.
he speaks the best of the present circumstances.

until the mind of Zeus should cease from anger.
